description: Source code for a custom test reporter class 'ListReporter' used in Playwright testing framework, responsible for displaying test progress and results in terminal environments.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays test execution progress, steps, and results with color coding and dynamic line updates.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, optionally printing a starting message.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test, assigning an index and displaying the test title.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Outputs standard output chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Outputs standard error chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step, displaying step information if configured.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updating the display with step duration and status.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the completion of a test, updating its result status and duration.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during test execution, displaying error messages.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test suite, printing final epilogue.
